description: MLB PROBABLE PITCHERS and posted STARTING LINEUPS per game for a date, from the official MLB Stats API — "who is pitching for the Astros tonight", "tomorrow's MLB probable starters", "is <player> in the lineup today". Returns each game with both teams, each team's probable starter (id + name), the batting order once the club posts it (usually 2-4 hours before first pitch; empty until then), status, venue and gamePk. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or omit for today; optionally filter to one team by id or name.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today's games.

team.description: Optional team filter — MLB team id (e.g. 117) or name ("Astros", "Houston Astros", "HOU").

name: mlb_probable_pitchers
title: Mlb Probable Pitchers
